events.factual_description: Rhizome DC presents Raphael Rogiński and Sarah Hughes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Doors are at 19:00 and the show begins at 19:30. Rhizome lists a $20-$30 sliding-scale ticket. Rogiński's set is explicitly billed as 'Plays John Coltrane and Langston Hughes,' performed fully solo on electric guitar with no overdubs or effects. The venue describes the program as reinterpretations of Coltrane combined with original improvisations and musical responses to Langston Hughes's poetry. The project originated as a 2015 Bôłt Records release and was expanded and reissued by Unsound in 2024 with four additional recordings. Rhizome bills Sarah Hughes separately and describes her as a performing and visual artist whose primary instrument is alto saxophone and who also plays soprano saxophone, flute and clarinet; the venue does not publish a specific instrument list for her October 21 set, so no live assignment beyond the documented practice is inferred. Rhizome's authorized Pools ticket page independently verifies the billing, date, doors, showtime, venue address and sliding-scale face value. The Polish Cultural Institute New York documents that Rogiński brought this same Coltrane/Hughes program to Rhizome DC on February 22, 2026 during an earlier U.S. tour, which is used only to calibrate recurrence and priority.

Repository-wide searches across canonical-indexed code, curated intake and processed history returned no October 21 Raphael Rogiński / Sarah Hughes candidate or proposed stable-ID match before publication. en.why_it_matters: The argument is in the transformation itself: Rogiński strips Coltrane down to one untreated electric guitar and rebuilds the music through space, blues feeling, folk memory and improvisation, then extends that listening frame toward Langston Hughes. Sarah Hughes adds a separate local improviser's voice rooted in reeds and a deliberately genre-free approach. In Rhizome's close room, the night is about how familiar source material changes when timbre, silence and instrumental identity carry almost all of the weight.
en.trip_verdict: If Wednesday is open in the DMV, this is an easy Rhizome night to keep on the calendar and worth the local trip. The same Rogiński program already reached this room earlier in 2026, so I would treat the return as a strong nearby opportunity rather than reorganize a broader itinerary around it.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento está en la transformación misma: Rogiński reduce a Coltrane a una sola guitarra eléctrica sin efectos ni overdubs y reconstruye la música desde el espacio, el blues, la memoria folk y la improvisación; después extiende ese marco de escucha hacia Langston Hughes. Sarah Hughes aporta una voz improvisatoria local distinta, anclada en los instrumentos de aliento y en una práctica deliberadamente libre de género. En el cuarto cercano de Rhizome, la noche trata de cómo cambia un material conocido cuando el timbre, el silencio y la identidad instrumental cargan casi todo el peso.
es.trip_verdict: Si el miércoles está libre en el DMV, es una fecha de Rhizome fácil de mantener en el calendario y vale el traslado local. El mismo programa de Rogiński ya pasó por este cuarto a principios de 2026, así que tomaría el regreso como una oportunidad cercana muy buena, no como motivo para reorganizar un itinerario más amplio.
